children: The Monetary Authority of Singapore is likely to tighten monetary policy again this month following July's tightening, OCBC Group Research's Christopher Wong says in a report. "Latest inflation dynamics warrant another calibrated move rather than a more aggressive tightening," the forex strategist says. OCBC expects the MAS to slightly increase the rate of appreciation of the Singapore dollar nominal effective exchange rate policy band while leaving the width and the center of the band unchanged. MAS monetary policy is centered on the exchange rate owing to Singapore's small and open economy. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
